title: The Heretic's Library
text: A library of forbidden books, kept under lock and ward by a Court that calls itself holy. The shelves go up into darkness. Some of the books are chained. Some of them are breathing. The librarian dozes at his desk, keys at his belt.

options.label: The wisest reads while the librarian sleeps.

outcomes.text: Things the Pact does not want known, written very carefully.
Something in the book reads back, and finds them interesting.
It is worth a fortune, and it breathes in the pack, and they will come for it.
He smiles in his sleep. On the step outside a single page has blown free, and the Leader reads it before they can stop themself.

options.label: The Abjurer reads the warded shelf.

outcomes.text: The wards are old, and the Abjurer learns how they were made by taking them apart, and wears what is left.
